description: CRASAR-U-DROIDs is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Robin Murphy, Texas A&M University (tamu.edu). This dataset contains 52 orthomosaics containing 21716 building polygons collected from 10 different disasters, totaling 67 gigapixels of imagery. Building polygons were sourced from Microsoft's US Building Footprint's Dataset, and in some cases building polygons were added manually by the authors. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 1 top-level file. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-fqy5-n314. Keywords: drone, sUAS, orthomosaic, building damage assessment, spatial alignment. Published 2024-08-11. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
